## Coaching Points

- Lower the bar in a slow and controlled manner between reps by keeping elbows slightly flexed
- Avoid pulling with the arms before attaining complete extension of the hips
- Catch the bar with elbows high, hips back, and eyes forward
- Keep elbows high in front to securely rack the bar on the front portion of the shoulders

## 1b. Barbell Hang Clean

Exercise Objective: Develop explosive power in the hips and legs and teach the athlete to utilize the stretch-shortening cycle
